work.title: CD Cross on Lace 2
work.description: Compact discs arranged in a cross formation dominate a layered background of white lace fabric and crinkled floral-patterned plastic sheeting. Four gold discs mark the corners of the composition, while iridescent silver discs form the cross, set against pale lavender-white textured material.
work.composition: cross formation centered on layered fabric
work.dimensions_source: CD reference: 2 of the many discs forming the cross (the two bottom corners), identical radius (95.2px native), 0% spread. Visually confirmed real, gold, unobscured discs. Estimated 2026-08-03.
